newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ROMA CHASE TETRADZE, TROTTA SAID TO BE LEAVING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMA CHASE TETRADZE, TROTTA SAID TO BE LEAVING.

text.p: Roma want Georgian defender Omar Tetradze to replace unsettled Argentine Roberto Trotta, newspapers reported on Friday.

The daily Corriere dello Sport said the serie A club had reached an agreement with Alania Vladikavkaz, Tetradze's Georgian club, to bring him to Rome as soon as a deal could be reached for Trotta's return to his native Argentina.
Roma are also interested in signing French international defender Vincent Candela from Guingamp.

The Frenchman was quoted on Friday as telling a Rome radio station that he wanted to move to Roma as soon as possible. "The (Guingamp) president knows what I want to do. I've been saying it since December."
Candela said he would meet the Guingamp president at the weekend to discuss the situation.
"I owe a lot to Guingamp but I don't want to miss the chance of playing in a big club like Roma," he said.
Trotta's future at Roma has been subject of much speculation since the club ordered the defender to go home to Argentina on two weeks' leave in October.
Trotta has been the target of abuse from fans after poor performances and was missing his young children who remained in Argentina.
